brief:
Today, Saturday 10 October, is Legs A, your first Legs A at the Singapore gym. Your last legs day was Legs B on 5 October, so your legs are rested. You wrote "Sick today" on Thursday's deadlift, and the deadlift dropped from 6 reps to 4, so your trainers kept the big lift where it was and only nudged the small machines.

The numbers: leg press with feet low 150, 170, 190 for 10, the same weights you used feet-high here on Monday. Bulgarian split squat 17.5 dumbbells for 10 on both sets. Leg curl 120 for 11 on all three sets, one more rep than Monday. Leg extension 120 for 12 on both sets. This is a guess, because you have not used this machine here yet. If it is clearly too light or too heavy, change it and log what you used. Adductor up to 90 and abductor up to 70, both for 12, because you hit 15 on every set on Monday. Calf raise 290 for 13, 12, 12, aiming to keep all three sets at 290 this time. Cable crunch up to 60 for 10, because 55 went 12 on every set.

If you still feel sick tonight, do the same weights and stop each set a rep or two early. Log it as you did it. Conditioning: easy only today.
